title: Regular-register action
statement: Let $r$ be one of $m$ Boolean work tapes, let $w$ be an optional instruction for writing on that tape, let $v\in\{-1,0,1\}$ be its head movement, and let $s$ be a state. The corresponding machine action leaves the input head stationary, applies $(w,v)$ on tape $r$, leaves every other work tape unchanged with its head stationary, emits no output symbol, and enters state $s$.
